title: PayoutMessage
description: The life of one payment for one pay obligation. ORP never holds or moves money: the money moves on a rail (stripe, lemonsqueezy, polar, manual, or an extension), and this message records where it is. The host sends a record to both parties at each state change. The payee answers a sent payout with confirm or not_received. A payout is paid only once the payee confirms or the rail's provider event says so.

PayoutRecord.title: PayoutRecord
PayoutRecord.description: Sent by the host. held: earned, inside the holdback. payable: past the holdback, waiting for the payer. sent: the payer or rail reports it sent. paid: confirmed by the payee or a provider event. reversed: a refund or a resolved dispute took it back. failed: the rail refused it.

ref.description: The rail's own reference for the transfer. Never an account number.

basis.description: What the amount rests on: provider events, the payer's own report, counted human clicks, or a verified receipt for per deal and per placement pay.
